feedTitle: Isle of Man 5 day shipping forecast

items.title: 5 day shipping forecast updated as of 30 June 2026 6:19am
items.description:
##Today##


##Warnings)##

Local strong winds at first.


##Wind)##

South 4 or 5 this morning, occasionally 6 to the west of the island at first. Decreasing South or SW 3 or 4 through the afternoon, veering West or NW later in the evening. Increasing NW 4 or 5 tonight.


##State of sea)##

Slight or moderate, falling slight for a time later today and at first tonight.


##Weather)##

Outbreaks of rain and drizzle, then becoming fair later this afternoon.


##Visibility)##

Good, falling moderate or poor in rain and drizzle.


##Temperature##

Min. air temperature 14°C and max. air temperature 17°C
##Sea Temperature##

14°C
##Tomorrow##


##Warnings)##

Strong winds later.


##Wind)##

NW 4 or 5, backing and decreasing West 3 or 4 tomorrow morning. Gradually backing and increasing South or SW 5 or 6 during the afternoon and evening, possibly occasionally 7 for a time overnight, then veering West or NW 5 or 6 later in night.


##State of sea)##

Slight or moderate, becoming slight for a time, then building moderate or rough.


##Weather)##

Fair, then patchy rain for a time.


##Visibility)##

Good, falling moderate in rain.


##Temperature##

Min. air temperature 13°C and max. air temperature 17°C
##Sea Temperature##

14°C
